## GHL 2. Secure Save-Card Page

**In simple words:** the safe page from the text link. The card goes into **Square's own secure box**. When it's saved, GoHighLevel gets the tag **card-on-file**, the time they agreed to the policy, and a note on the contact with the full record (proof if a fee is ever disputed).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ idempotency_key: 'card-' + $json.c.slice(0, 20) + '-' + $json.token.slice(-16), source_id: $json.token, verification_token: $json.verificationToken || undefined, card: { customer_id: $json.c, cardholder_name: $json.name || undefined } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ locationId: $('Config').first().json.ghlLocationId, phone: $('Consent Record').item.json.phone, firstName: $('Consent Record').item.json.firstName || undefined, lastName: $('Consent Record').item.json.lastName || undefined, customFields: Object.entries($('Consent Record').item.json.fields || {}).map(([key, field_value]) => ({ key, field_value: String(field_value) })) }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ type: 'SMS', contactId: $('Update Contact in GoHighLevel').first().json.contact.id, message: 'Thanks! Your card is saved with ' + $('Config').first().json.salonName + '. Reply YES to confirm your booking.' }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, message: 'Your card could not be saved. Please check the details or try another card.' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, message: 'Please tick the box to agree to the policy, or ask us for a new link.' }) }}
